links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified otolaryngology patient education materials (ALA and AAO-HNS), scored before and after ChatGPT 3.5 rewriting
links.outcome: Readability of patient education materials (Flesch Reading Ease and Flesch-Kincaid grade level)
links.effect: Overall FRE scores and FK grades improved significantly after ChatGPT translation (p < 0.001) for 37 ALA and 72 AAO-HNS topics. In Word scoring, AAO-HNS materials improved significantly overall (p < 0.001). Specific score values are not given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: Word did not show significant improvement for individual topics or subspecialty categories. ChatGPT's own scoring significantly exaggerated the change in FRE and FK compared with Word (p < 0.001). Accuracy and completeness of the simplified text were not reported.
links.quote: Overall FRE scores and FK grades demonstrated significant improvements following translation of materials, as scored by ChatGPT (p < 0.001).

design_hint: reading-level constraint prompting for patient materials
